far_family_comparison: Actual new174 top band visibly continues to screen-right cap side-end rivet; oldReady163 rivet is nearer screen-left upper strap. Same strap/rivet construction family supports this candidate, not identical screen-side coordinates or retrospective centralboss satisfaction.
material_observation: Muted tan/copper-gray plate surfaces, heavy dark ink rims, brown leather straps. Chest is broad curved plate, Near is rounded cap/rolled brim with central washer hole, Far is shorter compressed cap/end plane with band-side rivet.
different_perspective_observation: Near phases3/4 and Chest phase3 visibly change flange/plate skew; Far shifts modestly in cap height/end-plane. Phase0/5 resemble settle views. Unique files or different highlights alone do not prove six physically correct 3D poses.
